Freddie Mercury's love for his cats over the years was legendary. The cats of Garden Lodge—Mercury’s home in London—each had their own distinct personality. 

Meet Mercury's feline family as #TheWorldofFreddieMercury takes over #SothebysLondon this week: https://bit.ly/3YjUFGo
